item.title: AI Home Health Compliance Platform
item.description:
750-1500 USD | **Project Title: Custom AI-Powered Home Health Compliance & Operations Software**
We are seeking an experienced AI software developer or development team to build a comprehensive, web-based AI application for our Medicare-certified home health agency's **internal use only**.
The software should have a modern, professional dashboard with interactive charts, graphs, color-coded alerts, patient management, and automated AI-powered workflows.
**Required Features & Modules:**
1. **AI Referral & Intake Management** – Analyze referral documents, extract patient information, identify missing documentation, and assist with admission decisions. 2. **AI Clinical Chart Review** – Automatically review OASIS assessments, physician orders, face-to-face encounters, Plan of Care (CMS-485), nursing notes, and therapy documentation. 3. **OASIS Quality Assurance** – Detect incomplete assessments, inconsistencies, potential coding errors, and documentation deficiencies. 4. **Intelligent Medical Coding** – AI-assisted ICD-10 diagnosis coding, sequencing, HCPCS review, and PDGM-related validation. 5. **Medicare Compliance & RCD Review** – Evaluate homebound status, skilled necessity, medical necessity, physician certification, and pre-claim review readiness. 6. **Recertification & Discharge Assistant** – Track certification periods, evaluate clinical documentation, and generate draft recertification justifications. 7. **Authorization Management** – Review payer requirements, prepare authorization packets, identify missing records, and draft appeal letters. 8. **Denial Prevention & Billing Readiness** – Cross-check orders, eligibility, documentation, and coding to identify potential claim denials. 9. **Clinical Documentation Improvement** – Identify inconsistencies, missing signatures, incorrect orders, and weak clinical documentation. 10. **AI Clinical Assistant** – Suggest patient-specific goals, interventions, patient education, and documentation improvements for clinician review. 11. **Scheduling & Field Operations** – Assist with clinician assignments, scheduling, route optimization, and travel-time planning. 12. **Analytics & Reporting Dashboard** – Display compliance scores, audit findings, patient status trends performance graphs downloadable reports. 13. **Document & Patient Management** – Secure PDF uploads document classification organized patient charts AI-powered document search. 14. **Security & Administration** – HIPAA-compliant architecture role-based access audit logs secure cloud storage data protection.
Additionally: - We are particularly interested in developers who have built similar platforms before and can showcase their work or provide a demo of relevant past projects to demonstrate their expertise in this domain.
**Technical Requirements:**
- Integration with an existing advanced AI model through API. - Ability to analyze multiple clinical documents together. - Findings supported by document/page references and applicable CMS guidance. - Human review and approval of clinical and coding recommendations. - Clean modern responsive interface scalable architecture for additional modules future EHR integration full ownership of source code database application.

item.title: Mortgage Lead-Gen Platform Pilot Build
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Add on - Mandatory experience — GoHighLevel for Australian mortgage brokers
* You must have personally built or managed GoHighLevel workflows for an Australian mortgage brokerage. Both hands-on GoHighLevel experience and direct experience with Australian mortgage broking workflows are required. * Your experience should cover mortgage lead capture, email and SMS follow-up, discovery call booking, lead qualification and handoff to a broker. * Zapier integration experience is required. Direct experience with BrokerEngine is strongly preferred. * Applicants can be based in Australia or overseas. You must be available for agreed check-ins during Sydney business hours.
To apply, share one example of a GoHighLevel project you delivered for an Australian mortgage brokerage. Tell us what you personally built, how leads were qualified and handed off, and which systems you integrated. A short Loom walkthrough or anonymised screenshots are welcome.
I’m spinning up a proof-of-concept for KeepEasy Finance that lets Australian home buyers book a call with one of our brokers and, behind the scenes, creates a lead inside BrokerEngine using dummy data. The pilot will never touch production credentials—once the flow works, we’ll swap in live keys ourselves.
Here’s the flow I want to see: • Prospect lands on a responsive page, enters basic contact details, then chooses a time slot that aligns with the broker’s Sydney schedule. • On submission, the system fires a test payload to BrokerEngine (or clearly logs the API call) so we can confirm the mapping. • Both prospect and broker receive confirmation emails.
Deliverables: • Front-end landing page + form. • Calendar/booking integration (Calendly, Google Calendar API, or similar). • Backend script demonstrating the BrokerEngine link with dummy data. • Clear deploy notes and a short screen-share walkthrough.
Acceptance criteria: 1. A test lead appears in BrokerEngine’s sandbox or in a logged JSON object matching their schema. 2. Email confirmations render correctly in AEST. 3. Code is clean, commented, and can be redeployed with live keys in under an hour.
I need at least three hours of overlap with Sydney business hours each day. Experience with Australian mortgage broking or BrokerEngine will earn extra points, but solid API integration work speaks for itself. Let me know the tech stack you’d choose and link me to a similar integration you’ve shipped.

item.title: Bespoke API-Powered Report Builder
item.description:
3000-5000 GBP | I am looking to develop a bespoke web-based application for my business that will allow me to create professional, customised reports by integrating data from multiple third-party websites and platforms via their APIs.
The application should have a flexible report-building interface, allowing me to design and customise my own report templates rather than relying on fixed, pre-designed formats.
Key functionality required:
API integrations: Ability to pull data automatically from several different third-party websites and platforms via their APIs and populate relevant sections of my reports.
Custom text fields: Ability to create editable text boxes throughout the report, allowing me to add my own commentary, descriptions and professional opinions.
Dropdown menus: Customisable dropdown fields with predefined options to ensure consistency and speed up report completion.
Photo uploads: Dedicated sections where users can upload photographs, arrange them within the report and add descriptions or captions.
Custom report templates: Ability to create, save and amend bespoke report templates, including different layouts and sections depending on the report type.
Dynamic content: The ability for information retrieved through APIs, dropdown selections and manual inputs to automatically populate the relevant sections of the report.
Report generation: Ability to generate a final, professionally formatted report, ideally in PDF format, with consistent branding, layouts, headers and footers.
User management: Ideally, multiple users should be able to log in, access the platform and create reports, with appropriate permissions.
The overall objective is to build a flexible, scalable reporting platform that combines automated data retrieval with manual input, allowing us to produce our own bespoke reports efficiently.
I am looking for a developer who can advise on the best technology and architecture for this project, assist with API integrations and deliver a fully functioning application with an intuitive, user-friendly interface.

item.title: Dubai Salon Local SEO Overhaul
item.description:
30-250 USD | WordPress Technical SEO, Local SEO & Ongoing Maintenance – Dubai Beauty Salon
We are looking for an experienced WordPress SEO specialist to improve and maintain the website of an established beauty salon in Downtown Dubai.
The assignment consists of two phases. Applicants must quote separately for the initial project and optional ongoing monthly services.
Phase 1 – Initial SEO Optimisation (4 Weeks)
1. On-page SEO: Optimise the 11 existing website pages, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, service descriptions, internal links, image alt text and the online service menu.
2. Technical SEO: Audit and improve mobile/desktop speed, Core Web Vitals, caching, images, indexing, sitemap, broken links, redirects and structured data.
3. Local SEO: Optimise Google Business Profile, correct business information across relevant directories and improve local search visibility.
4. Keyword research: Identify relevant keywords for Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and nearby locations, focusing on hair, colouring, styling, nails, lashes, facials and other authorised services.
5. Analytics: Configure or verify Google Search Console, GA4 and conversion tracking for booking clicks, calls and WhatsApp enquiries.
6. Content: Improve existing service pages and recommend commercially relevant additional content.
7. Reporting: Provide a baseline audit, weekly progress updates, before-and-after evidence and a final completion report. Phase 2 – Ongoing Monthly SEO and Website Maintenance (Optional)
Please provide a separate monthly quotation covering:
1. SEO monitoring: Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, search impressions, website enquiries and booking conversions.
2. Content optimisation: Update existing pages and provide up to two SEO-focused articles or substantial content updates monthly, subject to Management approval.
3. Google Business Profile: Maintain business information, publish approved updates, monitor reviews and recommend improvements to local visibility.
4. Technical maintenance: Monthly checks for website errors, broken links, performance issues, indexing problems and SEO-related technical faults.
5. WordPress maintenance: Monitor plugin, theme, security and backup requirements. Updates and changes must be coordinated with our IT department.
6. Local SEO: Monitor business listings, maintain consistent contact details and undertake relevant, ethical local citation and back link activities.
7. Competitor analysis: Review relevant nearby competitors and recommend improvements based on actual search performance.
8. Monthly reporting: Submit a performance report comparing actual results against the previous month, explaining progress, outstanding issues and proposed actions for the following month.
Please specify which maintenance tasks are included and which require additional charges. Social media posting, paid advertising and major website development are not included unless separately quoted.
Commercial Requirements
Please provide two independent quotations:
A. Fixed total price for Phase 1, with an estimated four-week completion period.
B. Monthly fixed price for Phase 2, including clearly defined monthly deliverables.
Phase 2 will initially be considered for three months, subject to satisfactory completion of Phase 1 and separate Management approval.
There must be no automatic renewal or commitment to Phase 2.
Payments for Phase 1 will be linked to verified completion milestones, with no advance released to the freelancer.
All website changes require IT approval, backups and testing. Website and Google accounts must remain under company ownership.
Include 30 days of correction support for the initial project. Applicant Requirements
Please provide:
- Examples of similar WordPress SEO projects. - Experience with local SEO for service businesses. - Evidence of previous technical improvements. - Detailed deliverables for both phases. - Separate fixed project and monthly maintenance quotations. - Expected time commitment and reporting arrangements. - Details of any excluded services or additional charges.
We are looking for someone who can implement the required improvements and provide reliable ongoing support, not simply supply SEO audit reports.
